premises: Ag addition to TiNbZr HEA promotes in-situ tribo-oxidation forming a ~400 nm amorphous-crystalline oxide nanocomposite tribolayer
The tribolayer contains ~10 nm Ag nanocrystals embedded in an amorphous oxide matrix
This nanocomposite layer reduces friction coefficient to ~0.09 in ambient air
The nanocomposite layer reduces wear rate by two orders of magnitude compared to Ag-free TiNbZr
The mechanism relies on environmental oxygen reacting with the alloy surface during sliding
